u burn?

lmao

try bribery

im so tired today

yea

back to gus, what if i asked him for the recipe

random but do u like snow

buy boots

gross just kill it

why do u walk here
For an ale and some company. Writing alone all week makes a man glad of a crowded room.
u play pool?
Badly. I aim with confidence and miss with style.
game?

whats ur book called

leah told me ur secretly a fisherman lol

annoying

Fall 5. Another year, another gray hair.
how old will u be

lame
Perhaps, but it is my answer. A man writing a mystery ought to keep one of his own.
what do u want for it
A duck feather would make a beautiful quill. Squid ink would be even better, though it is expensive.
noted

deep

whats the best book here
For me, the book of sea stories by the window. For you, I would need to know what you like. What do you usually read?

this is strong
